title: Node CoAP relay integration still seeds removed ULA addressing
description: python/tests/test_node_coap_integration.py::test_coap_get_via_relay constructs fd00:: ULA endpoints and gradient destinations after Node moved to the required key-derived 02xx native primary. The request cannot be delivered, times out, and teardown exposes CancelledError. Update the integration fixture to use yggdrasil_address(pubkey) consistently for NodeChannel URIs and gradient destinations while keeping link-local next hops; add/retain the full A-B-C request/response assertion and bounded teardown.
